sections.title: IEDP Capstone – International
sections.description: Supervised international placement for students conducting applied research or internships abroad. Participants engage full-time in education and development work, connecting scholarly inquiry with practice in global contexts. Students pursuing a standard 3 month international placement will be able to enroll in this course once during their program of study. Students pursuing an extended 6 month international placement will be able to enroll in this course twice during their program of study.
